fact: On 30 August 2023 the Comandante Geral of the Polícia Nacional, Adulcinio Daniel, announced that the force would 'soon inaugurate' its integrated police information system, known as Zulu: it was not yet in service at that date, and the text names no esquadra using it.
title: Presidente da República diz que “a polícia tem de se modernizar para melhor servir e proteger a sociedade”
